pois.name: Doddabetta Peak
pois.description: The highest peak in the Nilgiri Mountains at 2,637 meters. Offers panoramic views of the surrounding hills and valleys. On clear days, you can see as far as the Mysore plateau.
tips: Visit early morning for clearest views before mist rolls in
Telescope house at the top charges extra for viewing
Carry a light jacket as it can be windy

pois.name: Ooty Lake
pois.description: An artificial lake created in 1824. Perfect for pedal boating and enjoying scenic views. The surrounding garden is well-maintained with a small toy train for kids.
tips: Boating costs vary by boat type - pedal boats are cheapest
Horse rides available along the lake
Best enjoyed in the late afternoon

pois.name: Pykara Falls
pois.description: Beautiful waterfall located about 20 km from Ooty. The falls cascade down in two stages surrounded by pine and eucalyptus forests. Boat rides available on Pykara Lake nearby.

pois.name: Avalanche Lake
pois.description: A pristine lake formed by a massive landslide in 1823. Known for its trout fishing and serene beauty. Surrounded by shola forests with stunning mountain backdrop.
tips: Best for nature lovers seeking solitude

pois.name: Pine Forest
pois.description: A scenic stretch of tall pine trees creating a mystical atmosphere. Popular for photography and film shoots. The road through the forest is a beautiful drive.
tips: On the way to Pykara - combine both
Great for photography in misty weather
No entry fee, just a forest drive

pois.name: Emerald Lake
pois.description: A serene dam surrounded by tea estates and eucalyptus forests. Less touristy compared to other lakes. Perfect for those seeking peaceful natural beauty.
tips: About 25 km from Ooty on the way to Silent Valley
Great picnic spot with minimal crowd

pois.name: Government Botanical Gardens
pois.description: Established in 1848, these 22-hectare gardens house over 1000 species of plants including rare orchids, ferns, and a fossilized tree trunk believed to be 20 million years old.
tips: Plan for flower show in May if visiting then
Italian garden section is most beautiful

pois.name: Rose Garden
pois.description: One of the largest rose gardens in India with over 20,000 varieties of roses spread across terraced slopes. Best visited during peak blooming season.
tips: Best blooming season: April to June
Located near the main town, walkable from bus stand
About 45 minutes sufficient for full exploration

pois.name: Tea Factory & Tea Gardens
pois.description: Visit a working tea factory to see how Nilgiri tea is processed from leaf to cup. Walk through verdant tea gardens and purchase fresh tea directly.
tips: Multiple tea estates offer tours - Doddabetta Tea Factory is popular
Buy orthodox tea for best quality

pois.name: Sim's Park
pois.description: A beautiful botanical garden in nearby Coonoor with over 1000 plant species. Less crowded than Ooty gardens with stunning valley views.
tips: Located in Coonoor, about 30 mins from Ooty
Annual fruit and vegetable show in May
Great for a quieter garden experience
Combine with visit to Lamb's Rock

pois.name: St. Stephen's Church
pois.description: One of the oldest churches in the Nilgiris, built in 1829. Features beautiful stained glass windows, timber framework, and old gravestones in the cemetery.

pois.name: Tribal Research Centre Museum
pois.description: Learn about the indigenous Toda, Badaga, and other tribes of the Nilgiris. Displays traditional huts, artifacts, and cultural items.

pois.name: Stone House (John Sullivan's Bungalow)
pois.description: The first bungalow built in Ooty (1822) by John Sullivan, the founder of Ooty. Now a heritage site showcasing colonial architecture and history.
tips: Limited visiting hours - check in advance

pois.name: Nilgiri Mountain Railway (Toy Train)
pois.description: UNESCO World Heritage steam railway built in 1908. The scenic journey from Ooty to Coonoor or Mettupalayam passes through 16 tunnels and over 250 bridges.
tips: Book tickets in advance online via IRCTC
Ooty to Coonoor is 1 hour, full journey to Mettupalayam is 5 hours

pois.name: Kingstar Chocolate Factory
pois.description: Famous chocolate shop in Ooty known for homemade chocolates. Watch chocolates being made and sample various flavors before buying.
tips: Try the fruit and nut chocolate
Handmade varieties more expensive but worth it
Multiple outlets in town, original on Commercial Road

pois.name: Shinkow's Chinese Restaurant
pois.description: Iconic Chinese restaurant since 1935, popular for its hot and sour soup, momos, and chili chicken. A must-visit for food enthusiasts.
tips: Try the famous hot and sour soup
Gets crowded during dinner - arrive early

pois.name: Earl Grey Cafe & Tea Lounge
pois.description: Cozy cafe specializing in Nilgiri teas and continental breakfast. Perfect for a relaxed afternoon with a view of the misty hills.
tips: Book window seats for best views

pois.name: Adderley Tea Room
pois.description: Heritage tea room serving traditional English high tea with scones, sandwiches, and Nilgiri tea. Colonial ambiance adds to the experience.
tips: Try the Devon cream tea set

pois.name: Sidewalk Cafe
pois.description: Popular vegetarian cafe serving Italian and continental dishes. Known for pastas, pizzas, and homemade bread. Great for vegetarian travelers.

pois.name: Hotel Nahar Restaurant
pois.description: Popular multi-cuisine restaurant known for authentic South Indian breakfast and North Indian curries. Good for families looking for diverse options.
tips: Try the masala dosa for breakfast
Lunch thali is value for money
Has both AC and non-AC sections
Near the bus stand - easy to locate

pois.name: Hyderabad Biryani House
pois.description: Authentic Hyderabadi biryani restaurant. Popular among locals and tourists for flavorful biryanis and kebabs.

pois.name: Garden Restaurant
pois.description: Pure vegetarian restaurant with garden seating. Serves South Indian, North Indian and Chinese vegetarian dishes. Family-friendly atmosphere.
tips: Outdoor seating has nice garden views
Good for kids with varied menu

pois.name: Willy's Restaurant
pois.description: Popular family restaurant serving Indian, Chinese, and Continental cuisine. Known for grilled chicken and sizzlers. Cozy ambiance for dinner.

pois.name: Boat House
pois.description: Main boating facility at Ooty Lake with pedal boats, row boats, and motor boats. Mini train and small amusement park for kids.
tips: Rates vary by boat type and duration
Pedal boats most popular for couples

pois.name: Dolphin's Nose Viewpoint
pois.description: A rock formation in Coonoor that resembles a dolphin's nose. Offers breathtaking views of the Catherine Falls and surrounding tea estates.
tips: Located in Coonoor, about 30 mins from Ooty

pois.name: Lamb's Rock
pois.description: A scenic viewpoint in Coonoor offering panoramic views of tea gardens and the Coimbatore plains. Named after a British officer who frequented the spot.

pois.name: Thread Garden
pois.description: A unique garden where all flowers are made entirely from thread. A labor of love featuring 500+ species of thread flowers. Guinness World Record holder.

pois.name: Wax World
pois.description: A wax museum featuring life-size figures of Indian leaders, sports personalities, and film stars. Fun for families with children.
tips: Combined tickets with other attractions available

pois.name: Upper Bhavani Lake
pois.description: Remote and pristine lake surrounded by grasslands and shola forests. Requires forest permit and is accessible only by authorized vehicles.
tips: One of the most beautiful spots in Nilgiris
No facilities - carry food and water

pois.name: Wenlock Downs (Golf Course)
pois.description: Vast rolling grasslands adjacent to the 9th Mile area. Features one of India's highest golf courses. Beautiful for evening walks and photography.
tips: Free to visit the viewing area
Great for photography during golden hour
Film shooting location for many movies

pois.name: Toda Huts
pois.description: Traditional barrel-shaped huts of the Toda tribe. Learn about the unique architecture and culture of this indigenous community.
tips: Part of a cultural preservation area

pois.name: Kamaraj Sagar Dam
pois.description: A peaceful reservoir also known as Sandynallah Reservoir. Less crowded alternative for boating and picnics with scenic surroundings.
tips: Boating available at lower cost than Ooty Lake

pois.name: Elk Hill Murugan Temple
pois.description: A beautiful temple dedicated to Lord Murugan, featuring a giant golden statue similar to the one at Batu Caves in Malaysia. Offers stunning views of Ooty town.
tips: Visit during morning hours for best atmosphere
Steps required to climb - wear comfortable shoes
Great for photography of the golden statue

pois.name: Catherine Falls
pois.description: Double-cascaded waterfall in Kotagiri. It is the second-highest waterfall in the Nilgiris, named after Catherine Cockburn, wife of M.D. Cockburn, the pioneer of coffee plantation in Kotagiri.
tips: Best view from Dolphin's Nose viewpoint across the valley
Can be accessed via a 2km trek for a closer view
Visible from the main road near Kotagiri

pois.name: Kotagiri Town
pois.description: The oldest hill station in the Nilgiris, quieter and less commercialized than Ooty. Known for its perfect climate and vast tea plantations.
tips: Ideal for long walks through tea estates
Quieter alternative to Ooty for stay

pois.name: Kodanad View Point
pois.description: Offers breathtaking views of the Rangasamy Peak, Catherine Falls, and the Moyar River. Known as the 'Terminus of the Nilgiris'.
tips: Morning mist makes it magical but can block views

pois.name: Mukurthi National Park
pois.description: A protected area designed to protect its keystone species, the Nilgiri tahr. Characterized by montane grasslands and shrublands interspersed with sholas.
tips: Strict permit required from the Forest Department
Guided treks are the only way to explore
Home to Nilgiri tahr and Nilgiri langur

pois.name: Cairn Hill
pois.description: One of the oldest cypress plantations in the Nilgiris. Features a nature trail, a hanging bridge, and a watchtower with great views.
tips: Nature walk is peaceful and well-marked
Hanging bridge is popular for photos
Quiet alternative to Ooty town gardens

pois.name: Coonoor Market
pois.description: A bustling local market in Coonoor where you can find fresh local produce, spices, local honey, and handmade oils.
tips: Buy local honey and Nilgiri eucalyptus oil here
Great for trying local street food
Experience the authentic vibe of the Nilgiris

pois.name: Moddy's Confectionery
pois.description: A premium chocolate shop and bakery in Ooty. Famous for its truffles, fudges, and wide variety of handmade chocolates.
tips: The dark chocolate truffles are a must-try
Can get very crowded - be patient

pois.name: Bison Valley Viewpoint
pois.description: Named after the Indian Gaur (Bison) that can often be spotted in the valley below. Offers wide views of the Bellakkal valley.
tips: Early morning is the best time for spotting wildlife
Road to the viewpoint is scenic but narrow
